question:
The positive value of

(1)/({1 + sqrt 2 )} + (1)/({sqrt 2 + sqrt 3 )} + (1)/({sqrt 3 + sqrt 4 )} + · · · + (1)/({sqrt {15) + sqrt {16} }} is
solution:
GIVEN: 

(1)/({1 + sqrt 2 )} + (1)/({sqrt 2 + sqrt 3 )} + (1)/({sqrt 3 + sqrt 4 )} + · · · + (1)/({sqrt {15) + sqrt {16} }}

**Formula used:**

a² - b² = (a + b)(a - b)

CONCEPT USED:

nth term= 1/(sqrt{n} +sqrt{n+1}) 

rationalization = process of converting irrational number into rational number.

CALCULATION:

The equation can be re-written as 

(1)/({1 + sqrt 2 )} + (1)/({sqrt 2 + sqrt 3 )} + (1)/({sqrt 3 + sqrt 4 )} + · · · + (1)/({sqrt {16) + sqrt {15} }}

On rationalization ,we get

(1)/(sqrt2 +1)× (sqrt2 -1)/(sqrt2 -1) + (1)/(sqrt3+sqrt2)×(sqrt3 -sqrt2)/(sqrt3 -sqrt2) +..................+(1)/(sqrt16 +sqrt15)×(sqrt16 -sqrt15)/(sqrt16 -sqrt15) 

⇒ sqrt2 -1 + sqrt3 -sqrt2 +............+sqrt16 -sqrt15 

⇒ -1 +sqrt16 = (-1 +4) = 3.

⇒The positive value is 3.
